VD_A6 t=1679.5 scene=LoungeScene wait Elara 80200 start reaction VD_A6 t=1679.5 scene=LoungeScene wait Elara 80200 start reaction ok after 0.0s VD_A6 t=1679.7 scene=LoungeScene dialog Elara 80200 start: 'So the Formless Horizon and the Stone Child Statue were found at the spot where Alex's signal cut off… What in the world happened here?' VD_A6 t=1680.5 scene=LoungeScene dialog Elara 80200 start: 'I found the name Alex in records from 10 years ago. There's a record of her being investigated as a victim in the child abduction case back then.' VD_A6 t=1681.3 scene=LoungeScene dialog Elara 80200 start: 'Child abduction case? Don't tell me you mean that one.' VD_A6 t=1682.1 scene=LoungeScene dialog Elara 80200 start: 'Is it a famous incident?' VD_A6 t=1683.0 scene=LoungeScene dialog Elara 80200 start: 'It was before the Dungeon Incident. At first it spread like just another urban legend, but it turned out to be real… A cult committed it to find offerings for human sacrifice.' VD_A6 t=1683.8 scene=LoungeScene dialog Elara 80200 start: 'You must have been quite young 10 years ago, Manager. You seem to know it well.' VD_A6 t=1684.6 scene=LoungeScene dialog Elara 80200 start: 'Uh… a close friend of mine was one of the victims of that incident…' VD_A6 t=1685.4 scene=LoungeScene dialog Elara 80200 start: 'Anyway, go on, Felix.' VD_A6 t=1686.3 scene=LoungeScene dialog Elara 80200 start: 'The police raid at the time successfully rescued the captured children, but it seems most of them couldn't readjust to society even after being freed.' VD_A6 t=1687.1 scene=LoungeScene dialog Elara 80200 start: 'In the worst cases, some even fell deep into the cult and went out searching for the very cultists who had abducted them.' VD_A6 t=1687.9 scene=LoungeScene dialog Elara 80200 start: 'Are you saying Alex was one of those cases?' VD_A6 t=1688.7 scene=LoungeScene dialog Elara 80200 start: 'Think about it. Alex clearly took the Stone Child Statue with her during the Hachishakusama incident. And the Formless Horizon?' VD_A6 t=1689.6 scene=LoungeScene dialog Elara 80200 start: 'Pim sold it through a community of Void Researcher. Come to think of it, Alex's profession was Void researcher.' VD_A6 t=1690.4 scene=LoungeScene dialog Elara 80200 start: 'If Alex willingly took those artifacts and sought out the dungeon's fanatics… what on earth was she trying to accomplish?' VD_A6 t=1691.2 scene=LoungeScene dialog Elara 80200 start: 'Alex was abducted, then freed, and spent some time in a psychiatric hospital — they say she often repeated these words.' VD_A6 t=1692.0 scene=LoungeScene dialog Elara 80200 start: '' VD_A6 t=1693.7 scene=LoungeScene dialog Elara 80200 start: 'I'm the suitable one. I… I should have been the vessel.' VD_A6 t=1696.1 scene=LoungeScene dialog Elara 80200 start: 'Hmm…' VD_A6 t=1698.1 scene=LoungeScene dialog Elara 80200 start: 'Elara. Investigate what exactly would happen with the Stone Child Statue and the Formless Horizon together.' VD_A6 t=1699.0 scene=LoungeScene dialog Elara 80200 start: 'Once the analysis is done, let's proceed with the next dive.' VD_A6 t=1699.8 scene=LoungeScene dialog Elara 80200 start: 'Hold on. How about contacting that friend of yours who was abducted back then? We might get some useful information.' VD_A6 t=1700.6 scene=LoungeScene dialog Elara 80200 start: 'Hm? Ah… that one didn't make it back.' VD_A6 t=1701.4 scene=LoungeScene dialog Elara 80200 start: 'Huh…?' VD_A6 t=1702.3 scene=LoungeScene dialog Elara 80200 start: 'The Compatible One that Alex mentioned. Maybe that was them.'
